messages:
Priya Menon: FYI incoming escalation from Support - Acurex trial can't complete onboarding. Customer sees 403 on /ingest and UI stuck on "verifying org". Trial expires in 8 days, big potential ARR. Can CS jump in? :exclamation:

support-bot: Ticket created: #5819 by Support. payload: user=acurex_trial, error=403 Forbidden on POST /v1/embeddings, attempts=4, assigned=@Kevin Li.

Kevin Li: Repro steps from Support: customer used prod API key in sandbox flow. Auth service returns org mismatch: 
```
403 Forbidden - tenant mismatch (org_id=3124 vs token_org=ak_prod_312)
```
They confirmed ingest passes with the temp sandbox key we provided once.

Priya Menon: Ok — prioritize. Jenna, can you loop in AE for renewal signal? I'll schedule a customer sync today.

Jenna Cho: On it. I emailed their AE (cc here) and flagged renewal risk: medium-high if unresolved >48h. I'll attend the sync and handle renewal messaging. :calendar:

Omar Reyes: Quick technical note: we can add a short-lived routing exception for their org alias (org_alias=acurex-3124) to let the prod key authenticate for up to 12h while they rotate keys. Prefer safer option: rotate customer key and update SCIM mapping. If CS wants us live for a few hours, I can push rule with TTL and auto-revert. Example rule: `allow_ingest_if org_alias=="acurex-3124" ttl=43200`

Priya Menon: Comms plan draft: 1) 4pm PT sync today to explain cause + immediate workaround, 2) SE-led enablement session for their dev team tomorrow to walk key rotation and SCIM mapping, 3) Confirm prod key rotation completed and close loop, 4) Offer a one-time credit and follow-up satisfaction survey before renewal. I will send the email draft in an hour for review.

Kevin Li: For tracking: ticket #5819 updated with logs and recommended steps. Marking P1 for now since onboarding blocked. Link: https://zendesk.example/ticket/5819

Jenna Cho: Internal action items I've captured: 
- AE outreach + renewal note (Jenna)
- CS sync + customer email (Priya)
- SE standby + potential routing rule (Omar)
- Update playbook entry with this pattern (Kevin)
I set reminders at 24h and 72h.

Omar Reyes: I'll prepare a tiny runbook snippet for the sync and stand by at 4pm PT. If we apply routing rule, I'll include rollback and TTL and coordinate with Ethan on deploy window.

Priya Menon: Customer confirmed 4pm PT works and accepted temp sandbox key. We'll try the direct rotation during the enablement session. Thanks team 44c

Jenna Cho: I'll bring up renewal timeline during the sync and offer credit if they see production impact. We'll try to close before trial end.

Kevin Li: Closing loop in ticket after sync. Will update status and escalate to SRE if routing change requested.

Priya Menon: Final: schedule sent, email draft in thread, SE on standby. Aim to resolve within 24h to avoid churn risk. :muscle:
